en.title: 10 Shows That Will Hook You Like SEAL Team
en.summary: If you're on the hunt for your next high-stakes military drama after finishing SEAL Team, this list is your mission briefing. We've compiled 10 gripping series that deliver intense action, complex characters, and the kind of realistic grit you crave.
en.body:
## 1. The Unit
This early 2000s gem is arguably the closest spiritual successor to SEAL Team, following a top-secret military unit tasked with the most dangerous missions. It masterfully balances intense combat sequences with the personal struggles of the soldiers and their families.

## 2. Strike Back
From the UK's Sky One and later Cinemax, this series throws you headfirst into the adrenaline-fueled world of Section 20, a black ops unit fighting global terrorism. With a relentless pace and globe-trotting adventures, it's known for its inventive action set pieces and a surprisingly deep exploration of its characters' bonds.

## 3. Generation Kill
This HBO miniseries offers a stark, unflinching look at the 2003 invasion of Iraq through the eyes of U.S. Marines. Notably, it enlisted veterans to ensure authenticity, providing a raw and realistic portrayal of combat that earned critical acclaim for its vérité style.

## 4. Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan
While Jack Ryan himself isn't a boots-on-the-ground operative in the same vein as the SEAL Team, this Amazon Prime Video series captures the high-stakes espionage and geopolitical thrillers that fans love. John Krasinski's portrayal of the CIA analyst thrust into dangerous field operations delivers plenty of tense moments and global threats.

## 5. Shooter
Based on the 2007 film of the same name, this USA Network series follows a highly decorated Marine sniper who is framed for a presidential assassination. It's packed with conspiracies, intense action sequences, and a relentless pursuit of justice, mirroring the high-stakes scenarios SEAL Team often finds itself in.

## 6. Six
History Channel's ambitious drama dives into the elite world of Navy SEAL Team Six, chronicling their dangerous missions and the personal sacrifices they make. The series excels at showcasing the brotherhood within the unit and the brutal realities of their covert operations.

## 7. Terminal List
Starring and executive produced by Chris Pratt, this Amazon Prime Video series is a darker, more intense take on the military thriller genre. Based on Jack Carr's novel, it follows a Navy SEAL's quest for revenge after his entire platoon is ambushed, offering a gripping narrative driven by loss and a relentless pursuit of truth.

## 8. The Brave
This short-lived but action-packed NBC series focused on the covert missions of elite government agents, blending tactical operations with the personal lives of those involved. It offered a fast-paced look at the sacrifices made in the name of national security.

## 9. Band of Brothers
While a historical drama set during World War II, this HBO masterpiece shares SEAL Team's focus on the bonds forged in the crucible of combat. Executive produced by Steven Spielberg and Tom Hanks, its meticulous detail and emotional depth make the soldiers' harrowing experiences utterly compelling.

## 10. Masters of the Air
From the acclaimed producers of Band of Brothers and The Pacific, this Apple TV+ series transports viewers to the skies during World War II, following the brave bomber crews of the Eighth Air Force. It combines stunning aerial combat sequences with profound human drama, showcasing immense courage under fire.

Bottom Line: These 10 series offer the perfect blend of tactical action, emotional depth, and compelling storytelling for any SEAL Team fan looking for their next obsession.

content_raw: SEAL Team fans looking for their next military thriller have plenty of action-packed options, from covert missions to globe-spanning espionage.
